description: FREE: replace the whole record set of a name you own -- never merged. The rental window is untouched: repointing a name you already paid for costs nothing. Ownership is proved by the paying wallet, with no account: send any placeholder signature once and the refusal returns details.expected -- the exact message to sign, in both forms (EIP-191 for a 0x wallet, ed25519 as 'solana:<base58 pubkey>:<base58 sig>'). Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST /feedback on this host -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

name.description: The full rented name, as returned when it was rented, e.g. example.448c.net.

nonce.description: A value you have not used before on this route; it stops your signature being replayed.

records.description: What the name resolves to. The route states the record and TTL limits in details.expected on any refusal.

ttl.description: Seconds, within the range the route states in details.expected.

type.description: A, AAAA, CNAME or TXT. TXT is how you pass a DNS-01 certificate challenge.

value.description: The record value: an address, a hostname, or the TXT string.

signature.description: Your ownership proof over the message the route names in details.expected.

signedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds at which you signed; the server accepts a short window around now.

name: dns_set_records
title: Repoint a name you own (free)
